correctness.rationale: Exact tail matching yields (1-a²z²)²=(a²-1)²z^{2m+2}; each positive root is necessary and sufficient for a square-summable eigenmode. Monotonicity and a single-turn derivative count one root always and a second exactly at (m-1)(a²-1)>2. Spectral symmetry and free-tail exclusion give completeness, and analytic Taylor/substitution arguments give both sharp limits and the unilateral compression radius. Supplementary finite-section checks passed but are not relied on for infinite statements.

Neither the adjacent-edge finding nor diagonal-impurity models specialize to the asserted off-diagonal two-bond secular equation without new analysis.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the explicit all-separation two-bond mode-count threshold, tunneling coefficient and simultaneous critical weak-enhancement limit. Prior work provides finite-rank Jacobi polynomial algorithms and adjacent-bond or on-site impurity results but none of the inspected comparable statements is identified as the full same bond-defect threshold plus two limits. Priority is qualified by targeted access and specialization risks.
residual_risks: Generic finite-rank Jacobi characteristic polynomial theory can be specialized; novelty is assessed for explicit all-separation mode threshold and coupled asymptotic, not generic solvability.

The critical-scale limit is established for fixed gamma and not uniformly across gamma depending on m.
